claim.claim-text: 1. A device for extracting material from an eye, the device comprising:

a hand piece (1030) comprising: a proximal, reusable portion (1033) configured to remain outside of the eye and comprising an aspiration pump motor (1115); and a distal, disposable portion (1031) releaseably coupleable to the proximal, reusable portion (1033) and comprising:

wherein the aspiration pump (1014) is a linear peristaltic pump comprising a central camshaft (405) extending longitudinally through a symmetrical double chamber pumping manifold (420), the central camshaft (405) having a rotational axis that is coaxially aligned with a longitudinal axis of the distal, disposable portion (1031).
2. The device of claim 1, wherein the aspiration pump motor (1115) rotates the central camshaft (405).

3. The device of claim 1, wherein the linear peristaltic pump further comprises two tubes (415) extending through the pumping manifold (420), each of the two tubes (415) comprising a longitudinal axis that is positioned parallel with the rotational axis of the central camshaft (405).

4. The device of claim 3, a first tube of the two tubes (415) is positioned on one side of the camshaft (405) and a second tube of the two tubes is positioned on a second, opposite side of the camshaft (405).
5. The device of claim 4, wherein the linear peristaltic pump further comprises a proximal flow path and a distal flow path

6. The device of claim 5, wherein the proximal flow path splits into two flow paths connected on a proximal end with the two tubes within the pumping manifold, and wherein the two tubes combine distal to the pumping manifold into the distal flow path.

7. The device of claim 5, wherein the camshaft (405) further comprises a plurality of lobed cams (425) that work in time to drive a plurality of cam followers (410) towards and away from the two tubes (415) to create sequential, progressive compression of the two tubes to push a fluid volume toward the distal flow path.
8. The device of claim 7, wherein motion of the plurality of cam followers (410) is in a plane perpendicular to the rotational axis of the camshaft and to the longitudinal axis of the two tubes.
9. The device of claim 8, wherein the plurality of cam followers (410) sequentially compress the two tubes in a wave-like fashion.
10. The device of claim 8, wherein the plurality of cam followers (410) apply no force in a direction of the longitudinal axis of the two tube and generate little to no friction on the two tubes.
11. The device of claim 1, wherein the cutting tube (1112) achieves up to 5000 cuts per minute and achieves a vacuum capability of 650 mmHg or 25 cc/minute volume.
12. The device of claim 11, further comprising a gear train positioned between the camshaft (405) and the cutting tube (1112) to engage and disengage the cutting tube (1112) as a clutch mechanism.
13. The device of claim 12, wherein the gear train effects a fixed ratio between the cutting tube (1112) oscillation speed and the camshaft (405) rotational speed.
14. The device of claim 1, wherein the cutting sleeve is exchangeable and configured to reversibly coupled to a distal end region of the disposable portion (1031).
